wikitext.*: {{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2016–17 |team=NC State Wolfpack |image=North Carolina State University Athletic logo.svg |image_size=100 |conference=Atlantic Coast Conference |division= |short_conf=ACC |record= 0–17 |conf_record= 0–14 |APRank= |CoachRank= |head_coach=[[Mark Gottfried]] |hc_year = 6th |asst_coach1=[[Orlando Early]] |asst_coach2=[[Butch Pierre]] |asst_coach3=[[Heath Schroyer]] |stadium=[[PNC Arena]] |bowl= |bowl_result= |wins_vacated=15}} {{2016–17 ACC men's basketball standings}} The '''2016–17 NC State Wolfpack men's basketball team''' represented [[North Carolina State University]] during the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Wolfpack, led by sixth-year head coach [[Mark Gottfried]], played its home games at [[PNC Arena]] in [[Raleigh, North Carolina]] and were members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]] (ACC). They finished the season 15–17, 4-14 in [[2016–17 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in a tie for 13th place. They lost in the first round of the [[2017 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] to [[2016–17 Clemson Tigers men's basketball team|Clemson]]. On February 16, 2017, head coach Mark Gottfried was fired, but the school allowed him to finish out the season.{{Cite web|url=http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/18699074/mark-gottfried-fired-nc-state-wolfpack-coach|title=Gottfried fired, will finish season at NC State|date=16 February 2017}} He finished at NC State with a six-year record of 123–86. On March 17, the school hired [[UNC Wilmington Seahawks men's basketball|UNC Wilmington]] head coach [[Kevin Keatts]] as head coach.{{Cite news|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/early-lead/wp/2017/03/17/n-c-state-hires-new-coach-kevin-keatts-away-from-unc-wilmington/|title=N.C. State hires new coach Kevin Keatts away from UNC Wilmington|newspaper=Washington Post|access-date=2017-03-21}} ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 NC State Wolfpack men's basketball team|Wolfpack]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 16–17, 5–13 in [[2015–16 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in 13th place. They defeated [[2015–16 Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball team|Wake Forest]] in the first round of the [[2016 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] before losing in the second round to [[2015–16 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team|Duke]]. == NCAA Independent Resolution Panel == As a result of the NCAA’s investigation into alleged violations in the men’s basketball program, the panel accepted the university's self-imposed punishment that included a fine and reduction in scholarships for the 2021-22 academic year. Additional punishments were imposed by the panel that included vacating the record for the 2016-17 season, an additional scholarship reduction, a one-year probation, a four-week recruiting communications ban and an additional fine.{{Cite web |date=2021-12-20 |title=NCAA/IARP Release Final Basketball Investigation Decision |url=https://chancellor.ncsu.edu/2021/12/20/ncaa-iarp-release-final-basketball-investigation-decision/ |access-date=2024-03-28 |website=Office of the Chancellor |language=en-US}} ==Departures== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
